title: The Long Grass
description: Let the meadow grow into tall grass, find the half-hidden path network, climb its wooden walk and emerge into open fields. Expert redesign: grass seedheads and low mowing rails.

signs.text:
The short meadow
Pass while the thorn head is folded.

Where the grass grows tall
Pass while the thorn head is folded.

The hidden path network
Pass while the thorn head is folded.

The wooden grass walk
Pass while the thorn head is folded.

The clear field
Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The short meadow
rooms.lesson: The first path is easy to read. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: Where the grass grows tall
rooms.lesson: Read the clear block tops beneath the grass. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The hidden path network
rooms.lesson: A side opening returns beneath the main trail. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The wooden grass walk
rooms.lesson: Climb onto the clear boards above the grass. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The clear field
rooms.lesson: The path and sky open up again. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
